versions.changelog:
- Initial release of farsight-intro-sequence skill.
- Enables generation of 100% original commercial intro sequences inspired by video structure, not content.
- Enforces strict anti-copyright rules and hardline originality (no names, no IP, no text, all new characters/plot).
- Guides user through context gathering, file setup, inspiration video analysis, prompt creation, image generation, and optional video animation.
- Requires explicit user selection of image and video generation engines for each project.
